_readme: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your courses.
The bot will alert you when NEW tee times open up (not for times already available).
How to find IDs for each platform:
ForeUp:    Go to the course booking page → DevTools → Network → search for tee times
→ grab schedule_id and booking_class from the query string.
TeeSnap:   Same DevTools approach → look for api.teesnap.net/v1/courses/{id}/teetimes
Chronogolf: Find the club slug in the booking URL, e.g. chronogolf.com/club/{slug}
Alternatively, just paste the booking URL into the Telegram bot and it will auto-detect!
